note: Cross-language conformance vectors, produced by the Python implementation. The Node and Go SDKs replay these and must reach identical verdicts. Evaluate every case at 'evaluate_at' — the signatures and credentials are real and time-bound, so a suite that uses wall-clock time would pass only in the five minutes after generation. A case's optional 'min_assurance' is an AgAL floor. Each 'sequences' entry is replayed in order against one verifier with one fresh replay cache. Each 'freshness_cases' entry is evaluated at its OWN 'evaluate_at', against trust loaded from 'delta_before_revocation' at the document's 'evaluate_at'; agents are refused (aidr.registry.unavailable) once that delta's signed iat is more than 'max_revocation_age_seconds' old.
